title: Review Exercise 3 · Q8
summary: Consider the set P = {x | x = 5m, m ∈ N} and Q = {x | x = 2m, m ∈ N}. Find P ∩ Q.

steps.title: Solution
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&P=\{5,10,15,20,25,30,\ldots \}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(multiples of }5)\\[5pt]&Q=\{2,4,6,8,10,12,\ldots \}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(multiples of }2)\\[5pt]&\text{A number in both sets is a multiple of}\\[5pt]&\quad 5\text{ }\textcolor{#047857}{\textbf{and}}\text{ of }2,\text{ i.e. a multiple of }10\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(L.C.M. of }2\text{ and }5).\\[5pt]&\therefore \text{ }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{P\cap Q=\{10,20,30,40,\ldots \}=}}\\[5pt]&\quad \{x\mid x=10k,k\in N\}\end{aligned}\]
